module: "Task Manager" window (fg_execution) of the Flowgraph editor: lists all loaded flowgraph projects (core_flowgraphManager.getAllManagers) with their state (running/stopped, hidden, transient) and lets you start or stop them all at once. On global start, applies the Mission Editor's mission variables via missionVariableHelper before setRunning(true). Hidden/transient projects are only visible with the flowgraph.debug.editorDebug preference.
notes: Can be displayed alone (drawAlone, title with ##alone suffix) or inside the editor (draw).
The global restart button is commented out in the code.

init.desc: Gets core_flowgraphManager and registers the window.

drawManager.desc: Draws a project's row: state icon, visibility, transient, name and buttons.

ExecutionView.desc: Draws the content: Projects header, Start All / Stop All buttons, then each project.

drawAlone.desc: Displays the window outside a project's context (self.mgr = nil).

draw.desc: Draws the window if it is visible.
